china-1928:p0903_1.rationale: Annual percentages of cotton samples rated up to standard in tests at the Shanghai association; the subject is cotton quality and adulteration, a commodity-trade matter.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for commodity quality testing or adulteration.

china-1928:p0904_1.rationale: Counts of mills, spindles and looms by Chinese, Japanese and British ownership in 1924 and 1925; this is cotton spinning and weaving industry capacity.

china-1928:p0905_1.rationale: Maximum and minimum spot prices of cotton yarn by brand and count on the Shanghai market in 1925.

china-1928:p0906_1.rationale: Monthly highest and lowest forward quotations of a yarn brand with total forward transactions in bales, a market-exchange price series.

china-1928:p0907_1.rationale: Maximum and minimum prices and total transactions in piculs of cotton by named variety.

china-1928:p0907_2.rationale: Monthly maximum and minimum forward-contract prices and transaction volumes for Nantungchow cotton, issued by the Shanghai Cotton Exchanges.

china-1928:p0908_1.rationale: Cotton mills, spindles and looms in China in 1925 by ownership (Chinese, Japanese, British).
review_questions: Should ownership-by-nationality of mills receive a tag? None fits in the vocabulary.

china-1928:p0909_1.rationale: Area under cotton cultivation and estimated crop in Nantung, Jukao and Haimen.

china-1928:p0910_1.rationale: Membership of the Indian Cotton Importers' Association, counting mills and merchants by city.

china-1928:p0912_1.rationale: Total tea exports from China in 1924 and 1925 in piculs and Hk. Taels.
